Panasonic Avionics Corporation is hiring an MTS I, Software to contribute to the research, development, and maintenance of real-time and embedded software. The role supports Linux/VxWorks configuration and hardware verification, and implements and tests software features and fixes in C/C++.
Information Technology & Services
No H1B
Responsibilities
Contributes to the research, development, and maintenance of real-time/embedded software under guidance. Supports OS/Kernel configuration (Linux/VxWorks BSP) and basic hardware bring up/verification via software. Implements features or fixes in C/C++ across device drivers, client-server apps, database-backed services, and basic security practices
Plans, designs, modifies and implements software applications from functional and system design specifications
Codes, integrates, tests, debugs, and refines the software to produce the required product
Develops software tools and subsystems to support software development, test, and reuse, and manages their implementation
Enhances software to reduce operating time or improve efficiency and robustness
Reviews, evaluates, and analyzes design interfaces
Prepares, reviews, and evaluates interface documentation, specifications, test plans and procedures
Assists in definition, analysis and allocation of requirements
Supports system test programs and analyzes system testing results
Maintains the developed software efficiently through familiarity with software lifecycles
Documents designs in engineering documents including functional block diagrams and data/logic flow charts
Assists in the troubleshooting and debugging of designs
Qualification
C/C++
Linux
TCP/IP Network Programming
Device Driver Development
Network Security
Multimedia Application Development
Streaming Audio/Video
Required
O-2+ years of experience in software development with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Sciences, Computer Engineering or Software Engineering
Or 4+ years of related software development experience in lieu of degree
C/C++ programming experience in Linux environment including TCP/IP network programming and device drivers are a must
Familiarity with a variety of the discipline field's concepts, practices and procedures
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and make efficient use of given resources such as system lab time and down stream process owners and tasks
Demonstrated engineering communication expertise including concise written and verbal skills is a must
Ability to work well in a small-team setting and interface with customer, i.e. in the way of engineering documentation
Ability to plan engineering activities to perform assigned tasks
All candidates must have valid authorization to work in the U.S
Preferred
Familiarity with network security methodologies a plus
Prior experience with multimedia application development including streaming audio/video servers and clients highly desirable
Benefits
Eligible for discretionary bonuses and incentives.
Non-exempt hourly employees accrue 14 vacation days per year + 7 sick days + 3 personal days; accrual rate increases with tenure.
All employees receive 11 company paid holidays per year.
The company closes its U.S. corporate offices between Christmas and New Year.
For operational positions expected to work on holidays, additional compensation for hours worked.
Medical insurance offerings from Aetna and Kaiser (CA & HI), with Employee Only, Employee + Spouse/Domestic Partner, Employee + Children, or Family options.
Dental PPO and DMO options and vision insurance through EyeMed or VSP.
401K with 50% match on up to 8% contribution, fully vested from day 1.
Washington residents only: Washington’s Family and Medical Leave program and Washington’s Paid Sick Leave program.
